radius-sm.description: px. Badges, checkboxes, small chips, tooltips.

radius-md.description: px. Buttons, inputs, selects, dropdown items, alerts.

radius-lg.description: px. Cards, popovers, dropdown menus, toasts.

radius-xl.description: px. Modals, featured cards, large panels.

radius-full.description: px. Pills, switches, avatars, spinners, pagination dots.

nesting-rule: An inner element's radius should be the parent radius minus the padding between them, never smaller than radius-sm.
